messages:
Avery: Quick GA readiness check for Predict feature — can we verify SLA, monitoring, docs, support training, and pricing before GA?
Sam: Infra quick note: supported. Propose latency SLOs: p99 < 400ms (short), p99 < 1200ms (long). Throughput target for Dedicated: 100 req/s per pool.
Priya: Reliability input: SLA draft = 99.9% uptime. Need runbooks + oncall escalation. Suggest credit formula: prorated monthly for >2 consecutive hours downtime.
Marco: Docs plan: quickstart, API examples, migration guide for v1->v2, and a "known limitations" page (quantization, token limits). I'll add a short checklist.
Nina: Support ops: will prepare Tier1 troubleshooting checklist, escalation matrix, and canned responses for billing/SLA questions.
Lydia: Pricing proposal: three tiers — dev (pay-as-you-go), standard (volume discounts), enterprise (committed + Dedicated). Need usage tagging by route for billing.
Sam: Also need observability hooks: token/sec, queue length, per-request cost estimate in console. Include trace id in response header for debugging: `x-rw-trace`.
Priya: Monitoring items: Grafana dashboards for availability, error-rate, p50/p95/p99 latencies, KV cache hit rate. Alerts: error-rate >0.5% for 5m, p95 > target*1.5. 
Avery: Action items — assign owners and ship ETA. Also legal needs SLA wording for terms.
Marco: Owner: Docs. ETA: EOD +3 days. I'll start a PR with quickstart and limitations.
Sam: Owner: Runtime & dashboards. ETA: EOD +5 days. I'll open infra changes and perf tests.
Priya: Owner: SRE & runbooks. ETA: Wed onboarding session 11:00 PST for oncall.
Nina: Owner: Support readiness. ETA: Wed training. Will draft KB and canned replies.
Lydia: Owner: Pricing. ETA: +4 days for pricing table and sample invoices. Need final SLA defined.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: 10% prod at 2026-03-25T02:00Z — if errors >0.5% rollback.
Avery: Quick sample SLA snippet for legal review:
```
SLA: Redwood Inference guarantees 99.9% monthly uptime for Hosted API; credits applied per terms for monthly uptime below SLA.
```
Avery: Anything blocking? Otherwise we move to canary and track the above metrics. :thumbsup:
Sam: No blockers from infra side. I'll post perf numbers after the test run.
Priya: We need one runbook review slot with support and docs — suggest Thurs 9am.
Nina: Confirmed Thurs 9am works for Support.
Lydia: Will sync with finance for billing tags before canary.
Avery: Thanks all — I'll summarize and open a follow-up thread with links to PRs/dashboards.
